description: Suggest which compliance frameworks may apply to a product, with a short reason for each, from a few yes/no answers about it. Use when the user asks 'which rules apply to us?' or before a first scan. Call it with no answers to get the questions to ask the user; then call it again with what you know and leave the rest out. Returns a list of frameworks to confirm with the user before running scan. Suggestions only: the user decides, ideally with a compliance professional. Read-only.

b2bCustomers.description: Do you sell to businesses, whose security teams may ask for SOC 2 or ISO 27001? True or false; leave out if unknown.

cardPayments.description: Do you take card payments? True or false; leave out if unknown.

decisionArea.description: Does the AI help decide something important about people? If so, which area (for example "employment" for screening job applicants, "credit" for loan scoring), otherwise "none".

digitalProductEU.description: Do you sell or supply software, an app or a connected device in the EU as a business? True or false; leave out if unknown.

euConsumers.description: Do you sell to consumers in the EU, for example an online shop, banking, travel booking, e-books or a messaging service? True or false; leave out if unknown.

euUsers.description: Do you have users or customers in the EU? True or false; leave out if unknown.

generativeAI.description: Does the AI create text, images, audio or video that people see? True or false; leave out if unknown.

governmentCustomers.description: Do you sell software to US government agencies or their suppliers? True or false; leave out if unknown.

healthDataUS.description: Do you handle health information for US patients, as a healthcare provider or for one (business associate)? True or false; leave out if unknown.

interactsWithPeople.description: Do people talk or chat with the AI directly, for example a chatbot or voice assistant? True or false; leave out if unknown.

mobileApp.description: Do you have a mobile app (iOS, Android, React Native, Expo or Flutter)? True or false; leave out if unknown.

personalData.description: Do you store or process data about people (names, emails, addresses, IP addresses)? True or false; leave out if unknown.

specialCategoryData.description: Any sensitive data, such as health, biometrics, ethnicity, religion, politics, sexual orientation or union membership? True or false; leave out if unknown.

usMarket.description: Do you sell in the United States? True or false; leave out if unknown.

usesAI.description: Does any feature use an AI model, including third-party ones like OpenAI or Gemini? True or false; leave out if unknown.

wantsCertification.description: Do customers or partners ask for a security certificate or report, such as ISO 27001 or a SOC 2 report? True or false; leave out if unknown.

name: classify
